description:
Show every attempt made for one invoice and what came back.

This is the tool that answers "why was it rejected". consult_invoice
gives the status; this gives the tax authority's own code, its
message, and the request and response exactly as they went over the
wire. Read-only.

It takes the invoice_id, like reissue_invoice — a rejected document
has no access key to look it up by. Get the id from list_invoices.

The rows are attempts, not documents: a reissued invoice has more
than one, oldest first, and only the last describes the current
state. Quote the authority's message rather than paraphrasing it;
the code is what the user will search for.

company_id.description: UUID of the company this call acts for, as list_authorized_companies shows it. Omit it when the connection covers a single company: that company is used. Required when the connection covers several — call list_authorized_companies to see them, with their ids and what each one allows. Give company_id or company_tax_id, never both.
company_id.title: Company Id

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company this call acts for — the company using Stackin, never the recipient or a taxpayer being looked up. Punctuation is ignored. Omit it when the connection covers a single company: that company is used. Required when the connection covers several — call list_authorized_companies to see them, with their ids and what each one allows. Give company_id or company_tax_id, never both.
company_tax_id.title: Company Tax Id

name: get_invoice_submissions

SubmissionAttempt.description:
One transmission attempt, and what the authorizer answered.

This is where a rejection's reason lives: `detail` carries the tax
authority's own words, and `raw_response` its full answer.

detail.description: The authorizer's message. The reason a document was rejected, in its own words.
detail.title: Detail

SubmissionAttempt.title: SubmissionAttempt

outputSchema.description:
Every attempt made for one document, oldest first.

Only the last attempt describes the current state; the earlier ones
are why it got there.
outputSchema.title: SubmissionList
